name: Falconhead West
title: Falconhead West Window Cleaning | Bee Cave TX | CleanzATX
description: Falconhead West window cleaning off Highway 71. Pure water exterior glass at $10 a window, spot free, with soft washing for stucco and limestone.
intro: Falconhead West sits right on Highway 71 at Vail Divide, with a mix of 2000s and 2010s homes and Bee Cave Elementary nearby. CleanzATX washes windows here on a regular route and can add soft washing for stucco and limestone.

sections.h2: What Falconhead West homes are like
paragraphs: This is the newer side of Falconhead. The plats read Falconhead West, Phase 1, Section 1 and on, and the first phase alone holds more than 165 homes, with several hundred across the whole area. Houses were built through the 2000s and into the 2010s, from about 1,900 to 4,900 square feet. The area is not gated, and it has its own Falconhead West HOA. Bee Cave Elementary is part of the picture for many families, so weekday mornings are busy and we plan around school traffic.

Exteriors are mostly stucco with limestone accents, the Hill Country look, and windows are the modern kind with big picture panes in the living room and across the back. Prices run from the mid $500s into the $1.4 millions, which means a lot of owners want a careful hand on trim and sills.

sections.h2: What Falconhead West windows deal with
paragraphs: Being close to Highway 71 matters. Traffic, road dust and the steady construction around Bee Cave settle on glass and sills, and a wet morning turns that dust into a gray film. Some lots here still have young landscaping, which means sprinklers hit the lower panes and leave hard water spots. Where trees have grown in, spider webs collect in corners and screens catch leaf litter.

Pollen is the seasonal piece. Cedar comes first, December to February, then live oak in March and April, and both coat window frames and stucco. We run the pure water pole system for the exterior and hand wash the interior with squeegees. Any limestone gets a soft wash, never a pressure washer.

There are no gates to plan around, so scheduling is simple. We usually book this area alongside the rest of Falconhead and the homes near Spillman Ranch Loop, since they sit close together. Since the section is HOA managed, we keep to daytime hours and leave the street clear. Owners who want the house looking right from the street often add a house soft wash with the windows, because the stucco shows highway dust before the glass does. Add screens at $5 each if you want them done too.

As an example, a 3,000 square foot home here is about $300 for exterior windows, with roughly two and a quarter to three hours on site. Doing the inside as well is about $450 at $15 a window, plus around an hour and a half.

why: Close to Highway 71, so road and construction dust is a regular part of the job.
Newer stucco and limestone homes get a soft wash, never high pressure.
No gates, which keeps scheduling quick and flexible around school mornings.
Tyler quotes by text, usually within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: Why do my windows get dirty so fast near Highway 71?
faq.a: Road dust and construction dust ride the wind and stick to glass, especially after dew or light rain. Regular cleaning, plus a pure water rinse that dries without film, keeps it from building up.

faq.q: Do you clean windows and stucco in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. Windows are done with the water fed pole system and the stucco gets a soft wash with the 12V rig. We can book both together, and the house soft wash starts at $0.20 per square foot with a $400 minimum.

faq.q: Can you work around school pickup times?
faq.a: We can. Tell us any hours that are tight and we place your visit in a window that suits. Most Falconhead West visits happen within about two weeks of your quote.

faq.q: What does my screen cleaning cost?
faq.a: Screens cost $5 each, with full screens at $10 and solar at $15. Plans that include a yearly free screen cleaning are Triannual, Quarterly and Every 2 Months.

faq.q: Do you offer plans in Falconhead West?
faq.a: Yes, the Clean Windows Club. Twice a Year saves 10%, Triannual and Quarterly save 15%, and Every 2 Months saves 20%. The higher plans include the 7 day rain guarantee.
